Category.Name: Administrative
Category.Description: Administrative Category. Sent from CTS to Participant.

Category.Name: Control
Category.Description: Control Category. Source may be either Participant or CTS Processor.

Category.Name: Indices
Category.Description: Index Category. Index messages provide index value information for a security.

Category.Name: Market Status
Category.Description: Market Status Category. Market Status messages provide market data information.

Category.Name: Prior Day
Category.Description: Prior Day Category. Reports CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond trades, corrections, cancels or errors for transactions that occurred earlier than the current trading day.

Category.Name: Trade
Category.Description: Trade Category. Reports CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond trade information including automated corrections, cancellations, errors, Trading Halts, Resumes, Indications and Imbalances.

Message.Name: Rejection Message
Message.Description: Used for all errors to notify a Participant that CTS has found an error in the Block Header, Message Header or Message body of a Participant Input message.

Message.Name: Warning Message
Message.Description: Sent from CTS to a Participant in response to a Block Sequence Number Gap. The block will still be processed by CTS.

Message.Name: Start of Day Message
Message.Description: Sent by CTS to a Participant to indicate CTS' readiness to accept data transmission. Consists of the Message Header only.

Message.Name: Sequence Information and Message Count Inquiry Message
Message.Description: Sent by Participants and the CTS processor to synchronize message sequence numbers. Consists of the Message Header only. Block Sequence Number must be set to Zero.

Message.Name: Sequence Information and Message Count Response Message
Message.Description: Generated by CTS to a Participant in response to a Sequence Information and Message Count Inquiry message. Transmitted in a separate block.

Message.Name: Line Integrity Message
Message.Description: Consists of the Message Header only. Bidirectional. Used for line keepalive; Block Sequence Number is not incremented for Participant-to-CTS Line Integrity messages.

Message.Name: End of Day Message
Message.Description: Sent by CTS to a Participant to indicate that the Participant should not transmit any further messages to CTS. Consists of the Message Header only.

Message.Name: Test Message
Message.Description: Generated by CTS or a Participant to exercise the line and verify transmission integrity. Transmitted as the only message in a block.

Message.Name: Index Message
Message.Description: Contains the index and the index value.

Message.Name: Bid and Offer Index Message
Message.Description: Contains the Bid and Offer index values.

Message.Name: Approximate Trades and Total Dollar Value Message
Message.Description: Allows a Participant to report the total trades and total dollar value of trades at their respective market centers.

Message.Name: Crossing Session Message
Message.Description: Used to report the total volume and dollar value of trades transacted after the close of a Participant's regular session.

Field.Name: Crossing Session I Total Trades Volume
Crossing Session II Total Trades Volume

Message.Name: Prior Day Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Used to correct a transaction originally reported earlier than the current day.

Field.Name: Corrected Prior Day Trade Date and Time
Original Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Fractional Prior Day Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Used to correct a prior day transaction when either the original or corrected volume is a fractional value.

Field.Name: Corrected Prior Day Trade Date and Time
Original Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Prior Day Trade Message
Message.Description: Reports a CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond transaction which occurred earlier than the current trading day and was not reported.

Field.Name: Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Fractional Prior Day Trade Message
Message.Description: Reports a trade with fractional volume which occurred earlier than the current trading day and was not reported.

Field.Name: Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Prior Day Trade Cancel/Error Message
Message.Description: Used to cancel or error a trade or correction originally reported earlier than the current day.

Field.Name: Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Fractional Prior Day Trade Cancel/Error Message
Message.Description: Reports the cancellation or error of a fractional trade or correction originally reported earlier than the current day.

Field.Name: Prior Day Trade Date and Time

Message.Name: Auction Status Message
Message.Description: Transmitted when a Participant in a CTA eligible security requires Auction Information. Initial Auction Collar is published after the LULD Trading Pause.

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Used to correct CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond trade information.

Message.Name: Fractional Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Used to correct a trade when the corrected Trade Volume is a fractional value.

Message.Name: Long Trade Message
Message.Description: Used to report trade information for CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bonds.

Message.Name: Fractional Long Trade Message
Message.Description: Used to report trade information for CTA eligible Equity, Local Issues or Bonds in fractional volume.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: Allows a Participant that is the listing exchange to notify CTS of Trading Halts, Resumes, Indications, Imbalances, Short Sale Restriction Indicators and LULD Reference Prices. Bidirectional.

Field.Name: Last Price / Opening (Reopening) LULD Reference Price
High Indication Price / Upper Limit Price Band
Low Indication Price / Lower Limit Price Band

Message.Name: Short Trade Message
Message.Description: Reports trade information for CTA eligible Equity, Local Issues or Bonds when the trade meets all criteria for the compact Short format; otherwise the Long Trade message is used.

Message.Name: Fractional Short Trade Message
Message.Description: Reports trade information with fractional volume when the trade meets all criteria for the compact Short format; otherwise the Long Trade or Fractional Long Trade message is used.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel/Error Message
Message.Description: Allows a Participant to cancel or error trade reports for CTA eligible Equity, Local Issue or Bond originally reported using a fixed message format.

Struct.Name: Timestamp 2
Struct.Description: FINRA ADF or TRF provided timestamp; nanoseconds since Epoch as (seconds, nanoseconds)

Struct.Name: Prior Day Trade Date and Time
Struct.Description: Date and time the prior day trade was executed; nanoseconds since Epoch as (seconds, nanoseconds)

Struct.Name: Corrected Prior Day Trade Date and Time
Struct.Description: Corrected date and time the prior day trade was executed; nanoseconds since Epoch as (seconds, nanoseconds)

Struct.Name: Original Prior Day Trade Date and Time
Struct.Description: Original date and time the prior day trade was executed; nanoseconds since Epoch as (seconds, nanoseconds)

Struct.Name: Sale Condition 4
Struct.Description: Sale Condition field as four positional Category levels (Settlement Type, Reason for Trade-Through Exemption / Other Reason, Extended Hours / Sequence Type, SRO Trade Detail)

Type.Name: Administrative Message Type
Type.Description: Identifies the type of Administrative message

Type.Name: Control Message Type
Type.Description: Identifies the type of Control message

Type.Name: Indices Message Type
Type.Description: Identifies the type of Index message

Type.Name: Market Status Message Type
Type.Description: Identifies the type of Market Status message

Type.Name: Prior Day Message Type
Type.Description: Identifies the type of Prior Day message

Type.Name: Trade Message Type
Type.Description: Identifies the type of Trade message

Type.Name: Error Code
Type.Description: Error code indicating the first error encountered while validating the rejected Participant input message

Type.Name: Previous Block Sequence Number
Type.Description: Block Sequence Number prior to the gap that triggered the Warning

Type.Name: Previous Participant Reference Number
Type.Description: Participant Reference Number prior to the gap that triggered the Warning

Type.Name: Current Block Sequence Number
Type.Description: Next expected Participant Block Sequence Number returned by CTS in a Sequence Information and Message Count Response

Type.Name: Last Participant Reference Number
Type.Description: Last Participant Reference Number received by CTS on the individual line

Type.Name: Message Count
Type.Description: Count of messages received on the individual line since startup. Excludes Line Integrity and Sequence Information and Message Count Inquiry messages

Type.Name: Data
Type.Description: All ASCII characters starting with hex 0 and ending hex FF, in sequential order

Type.Name: Security Symbol
Type.Description: Left justified, space-filled. Root symbol may be 1 to 6 characters with remaining characters available for possible suffixes

Type.Name: Index Symbol
Type.Description: Left justified, space-filled. Contains the Index symbol

Type.Name: Index Value
Type.Description: Index value (not a price) with implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Bid Index Value
Type.Description: Index value (not a price) representing the index's calculation formula using current Bid values of the component securities. Implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Offer Index Value
Type.Description: Index value (not a price) representing the index's calculation formula using current Offer values of the component securities. Implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Instrument Type
Type.Description: Identifies the instrument type relevant to the trade

Type.Name: Auction Collar Reference Price
Type.Description: Price used by the exchange to establish the Auction Collar. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Auction Collar Upper Threshold Price
Type.Description: Latest upper threshold price of the Auction Collar. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Auction Collar Lower Threshold Price
Type.Description: Latest lower threshold price of the Auction Collar. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Number of Extensions
Type.Description: Number of manual or automatic extensions the applicable auction has received. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Reserved 62
Type.Description: Reserved for future use (TBD)

Type.Name: Reserved 3
Type.Description: Reserved for future use (TBD)

Type.Name: Total Trades
Type.Description: Total number of trade transactions executed from a Participant. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Dollar Value
Type.Description: Total dollar worth of the daily trade transactions. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Crossing Session I Total Trades Volume
Type.Description: Shares traded at the Participant's close price after the close of the Participant's regular session. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Crossing Session II Dollar Value
Type.Description: Dollar Value traded after the close of the Participant's regular session. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Crossing Session II Total Trades Volume
Type.Description: Shares traded after the close of the Participant's regular session. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Sale Condition
Type.Description: Sale Condition for Long-form messages. Four positional Category levels per Sale Condition table

Type.Name: Corrected Sale Condition
Type.Description: Corrected Sale Condition. Four positional Category levels per Sale Condition table

Type.Name: Original Sale Condition
Type.Description: Original Sale Condition. Four positional Category levels per Sale Condition table

Type.Name: Sale Condition Category
Type.Description: Identifies the Sale Condition Category level associated with a Short Trade

Type.Name: Trade Price
Type.Description: Monetary value of an individual share at the time of the trade. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Trade Price 2
Type.Description: Monetary value of an individual share at the time of the trade (short form). Implied 2 decimal places

Type.Name: Corrected Trade Price
Type.Description: Corrected monetary value of an individual share. Implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Original Trade Price
Type.Description: Original monetary value of an individual share. Implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Trade Volume
Type.Description: Total number of shares traded in a single transaction for an individual security

Type.Name: Trade Volume 2
Type.Description: Total number of shares traded in a single transaction for an individual security (short form)

Type.Name: Corrected Trade Volume
Type.Description: Corrected total number of shares traded

Type.Name: Original Trade Volume
Type.Description: Original total number of shares traded

Type.Name: Fractional Trade Volume
Type.Description: Total number of shares (represented in fraction) traded in a single transaction. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Fractional Trade Volume 4
Type.Description: Total number of shares (represented in fraction) traded in a single transaction (short form). Implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Corrected Fractional Trade Volume
Type.Description: Corrected total number of shares (represented in fraction) traded. Implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Original Fractional Trade Volume
Type.Description: Original total number of shares (represented in fraction) traded. Implied 6 decimal places

Type.Name: Seller's Sale Days
Type.Description: Number of days that may elapse before delivery of the security. Allowed values 2 through 60. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Corrected Seller's Sale Days
Type.Description: Corrected Seller's Sale Days. Allowed values 2 through 60. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Original Seller's Sale Days
Type.Description: Original Seller's Sale Days. Allowed values 2 through 60. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Stop Stock Indicator
Type.Description: Identifies whether a trade is considered a stop stock at the time of the trade

Type.Name: Corrected Stop Stock Indicator
Type.Description: Corrected Stop Stock Indicator

Type.Name: Original Stop Stock Indicator
Type.Description: Original Stop Stock Indicator

Type.Name: Trade Through Exempt Indicator
Type.Description: Denotes whether or not a trade is exempt (Rule 611) and, when used jointly with certain Sale Conditions, describes the characteristics of a particular trade

Type.Name: Corrected Trade Through Exempt Indicator
Type.Description: Corrected Trade Through Exempt Indicator

Type.Name: Original Trade Through Exempt Indicator
Type.Description: Original Trade Through Exempt Indicator

Type.Name: Short Sale Restriction Indicator
Type.Description: Identifies whether or not a Short Sale Restriction is in effect by the Primary Listing Market for a security

Type.Name: Corrected Short Sale Restriction Indicator
Type.Description: Corrected Short Sale Restriction Indicator

Type.Name: Original Short Sale Restriction Indicator
Type.Description: Original Short Sale Restriction Indicator

Type.Name: Trade Reporting Facility ID
Type.Description: Identifies the Participant with whom a Trade Reporting Facility (TRF) has been formed. Space-filled when TRF Not Applicable

Type.Name: Cancel/Error Action
Type.Description: Denotes whether the referenced transaction is to be cancelled or errored

Type.Name: Last Price / Opening (Reopening) LULD Reference Price
Type.Description: Last price for a security; when Security Status is set to LULD Reference Price, contains the Opening (Reopening) LULD Reference Price reported by the listing exchange. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: High Indication Price / Upper Limit Price Band
Type.Description: High Indication Price for trading range or, when paired with LULD Trading Pause, the Upper Limit Price Band. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Low Indication Price / Lower Limit Price Band
Type.Description: Low Indication Price for trading range or, when paired with LULD Trading Pause, the Lower Limit Price Band. Implied 6 decimal places. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Buy Volume
Type.Description: Reported imbalance of buy orders without matching sell orders for the security for a Participant. Optional set to zero

Type.Name: Sell Volume
Type.Description: Reported imbalance of sell orders without matching buy orders for the security for a Participant

Type.Name: Security Status
Type.Description: Trading action related to the transaction

Type.Name: Halt Reason
Type.Description: Reason for a Trading Halt

Type.Name: Trading Status ID
Type.Description: Unique identifier for each Trading Status Message; used to eliminate duplicate Trading Status messages received over CQS and CTS input lines

Type.Name: Original Participant Reference Number
Type.Description: Participant Reference Number of the original transaction being corrected, cancelled or errored
